final: WITH linked_fees AS (SELECT o.orderbase, f.feerate FROM fees AS f JOIN orders AS o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault), channel_avgs AS (SELECT orderbase, AVG(feerate) AS avg_feerate FROM linked_fees GROUP BY orderbase), benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(feerate) AS avg_feerate FROM linked_fees) SELECT AVG(c.avg_feerate) AS mean_above_benchmark, AVG(c.avg_feerate - b.avg_feerate) AS mean_excess FROM channel_avgs AS c CROSS JOIN benchmark AS b WHERE c.avg_feerate > b.avg_feerate
